testCases.title: Verify brand filter checkboxes are displayed in the sidebar.
steps: Navigate to the product filtering page.
expectedResults: Brand filter checkboxes are displayed in the sidebar.

testCases.title: Verify that selecting brand checkboxes updates the product grid.
steps: Select one or more brand checkboxes in the sidebar.
expectedResults: Product grid updates to show only products from the selected brands.

testCases.title: Verify that both categories and brands filters work together.
steps: Select one or more category filters.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
expectedResults: Product grid updates to show only products matching both selected categories and brands.
